title: German Roast Pork
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring a tender and juicy roasted pork shoulder.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and jubilant spices.
Heat the roasted german beer in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a plate and set aside.
Add the roasted vegetables and roast potatoes to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Return the pork to the pot and add enough liquid to cover the bottom of the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
